_comment: Campaign kit (M1, M2). Kitchen pieces are bought on the spot from the kit bar; crated pieces (crate: true) are ordered on the laptop, delivered by van, and placed from stock. Pieces cost credits and refund salvage when picked up empty; a crated piece goes back into its crate instead. Sprites are regions of art/equipment.png; inside is the clear region where the contents are painted, over back (the vessel's inner wall; dark steel if not given). Gas and electricity are billed per kJ as the stoves, kettle, pumps and centrifuge use them. Pieces with furnish: true are the base's vessels (docs/design/rooms.md), bought in furnish mode instead of the kit bar; their sprites come from their own sheet, and surface (the vat's) is the opening's shape, painted over the sprite in the liquid's colour.

items.name: Gas stove
items.note: Off, low 600 W, medium 1200 W, high 2000 W. Pans stand on top.

items.name: Sink
items.note: Tap water and a drain within reach; a pan stood in it sits in a cold bath.

items.note: Somewhere to stand molds and pans.
